title: Improving the electrocatalytic activity of Pd nanoparticles through electronic coupling interaction with a Ni2P–MoS2 hybrid support for ethanol electro-oxidation in an alkaline medium
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1552-1564
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01223B, Paper

Thabo Matthews, Makhaokane Paulina Chabalala, Siyabonga Patrick Mbokazi, Memory Zikhali, Tarekegn Heliso Dolla, Anatolijs Šarakovskis, Guntars Vaivars, Tunde Lewis Yusuf, Rhiyaad Mohamed, Nobanathi Wendy Maxakato
Pd/Ni2P–MoS2 hybrid shows improved electrocatalytic activity for ethanol electrooxidation. The interaction between Pd and the support enhances reaction kinetics and stability in alkaline environments, leading to better overall performance.
